instruction: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.

questions.question_text: Some people believe that unpaid community service should be a compulsory part of high school programmes. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
questions.explanation: This essay prompt requires assessment across 4 IELTS criteria: Task Achievement, Coherence & Cohesion, Lexical Resource, and Grammatical Range & Accuracy.
questions.explanation_vi: Đề bài nghị luận xã hội yêu cầu chấm điểm qua AI Gemini theo 4 tiêu chí chuẩn IELTS.
